paralycopodites.note: All eight actual512px images opened individually. Main trunk, two crown leaders and opposed rows read consistently from hero/reverse/front/rear; side is intentionally narrow and top confirms true-depth unequal twigs. Small cones and microphylls remain subtle at whole-plant scale, not claimed clearly resolved in every frame. No floating joint or exposed folding seen. Historical anatomy does not prove whole habit;2020 branch inference remains explicit.

lyginopteris.note: All eight actual512px images opened individually. Living stem leans against separately colored subordinate dead support; no twining claim. Lobed divided foliage is especially clear in top and visible at oblique views; edge-on front/side leaves are expected finite-thickness blades, not missing geometry. Sparse gland bases do not form bead rings. Actual support joint and all plant bases measured. No floating base or exposed interference seen.

medullosa.note: All eight actual512px images opened individually. Multi-order compound crown spans several azimuths; top exposes the branched fans and elongate pinnules, oblique views show depth. Stem has quiet bare intervals and sparse stubs, not continuous pineapple armor. R002 folded dark stem band is absent in r003 color, reverse, side and clay. No camera or shader workaround. Erect habit remains one reconstruction hypothesis, not genus-wide fact.

cordaites.note: All eight new actual512px images opened individually, not the interrupted five-frame attempt. Upper woody limbs bear simple broad ribbons with parallel-sided middle spans and equal subtle vein bands; lower trunk is quiet. Top and reverse expose true depth and asymmetric crown. Fine edge-on leaves are visible as thin lines in side views. No dominant raised midrib, compound frond, floating joints or main-axis self-folding seen. Juvenile upland habit and colors remain artistic.
